about: The data every Team capacity design frame is drawn from, and that the built page's fixture preview must render (claude-config#1364). Advisor names are invented.

pace.about: Each day's latest booking pace reading, in the columns capacity_fill_readings stores (#4102, #4103, and from 95% the last call estimate, #4190), one per snapshot day in order, read at readAt. A frame's own "pace" replaces a day's reading by its index; "paceReadAt" moves when the readings were last taken; "paceFailed" makes the read fail.
